cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a starship galley and mess hall — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
